description: Puts a mix under the video: two-pass loudness to -14 LUFS, true peak -1.2 dB, optional film grain. A mix shorter than the video is padded with silence, a longer one cut at the end. Before handing over, it checks the frame count and that the sound starts and ends with the picture. Returns the output path and the measured loudness.
name: mux_audio
title: Mux and master sound
